g_id_rule: g_id = floor((lat + 90) / 0.05) * 7200 + floor((lon + 180) / 0.05); the cell centre is the lower-left corner plus 0.025 degree
district_rule: index into districts[] of districts/index.json; the district that contains the cell centre, or the nearest one within 0.05 degree

left_out.why: centre more than 0.05 degree from every district (sea, or outside Indonesia)
